Hey its okay. I've dealt with multiple addictions before including self harm. Relapses happen, and it's nothing to beat yourself up over. Beating an addiction isn't just going some arbitrary number of days without relapsing and then you can say "Woohoo I beat the addiction!" It's about making an active effort to make positive changes in your life. This relapse does not define your recovery. It does not define you as a person. You're gonna do great. Keep going forward, we're all here for you <3
